source_reconstruction_scope: The CharacterList source producer and exact _UpdateAggro Search(float,float,IObjectList&) call boundary. The normalized runtime query accepts a flat borrowed CharacterList and does not use PFRoom or RoomZone grouping.
file_offset_policy: Pinned ARM32 ELF .text virtual addresses match file offsets for the recorded code ranges. The runner checks the complete library SHA, ELF symbols/ranges, vtable relocation results, and all recorded bytes before executing original ARM code.

source IObjectList Reset/AtEnd/Get/GetChar/Next caller and candidate search
sets current from sentinel next and end from sentinel
advances current through current node next link
returns current node value as GameObject*
returns the same current node value as Character*

unsupported: The host CharacterList query is not wired into the Android actor or a native ObjectManager owner yet.
ObjectManager Character Add/Remove/destruction production and lifetime ownership are not reconstructed by this adapter.

The ARM runner executes the exact Search(float,float,IObjectList&) caller through its call boundary and directly executes the original CharacterList virtuals; it does not execute the full Search(point,...) candidate body because that function requires uninitialized game-global diagnostics/runtime services.
PFRoom/RoomZone membership and their circular registries are separate APIs and are not used as an aggro candidate list.
